columnHelp.contributor: Player credited (Goalscorer / Assist / Goals+Assists depending on dataset).
columnHelp.exp_points_collected_timed: EP collected: each goal or SCA1 credit at its time-aware value V(gd + 1, bin) − V(gd, bin).
columnHelp.exp_points_collected_untimed: The same goals at their time-blind value U(gd + 1) − U(gd).
columnHelp.delta_ep_timed_vs_untimed: Time-aware minus time-blind EP. It drifts below zero with volume (most goals from level come early, when they are worth less than the time-blind average), so it is not a clutch measure; the editorial page's timing premium corrects for that.
columnHelp.delta_ep_minus_goals: Timed EP collected minus goals involved.
columnHelp.ratio_ep_per_goal: Timed EP collected divided by goals involved.
columnHelp.gd_before: Goal difference for the scoring team before the goal.
columnHelp.gd_after: Goal difference for the scoring team after the goal.
columnHelp.minute_bin: 15-minute time bin when the goal occurred.
columnHelp.pW: Share of team-minutes in this state whose team went on to win.
columnHelp.exp_points_collected: Value of the goal: state value after minus state value before.
columnHelp.delta_exp_points: EP delta from state value function (Approach A).
columnHelp.minutes_played: Minutes played in the same matches and scope as the goals (all six leagues).
columnHelp.ep_per_90: Time-aware EP per 90 minutes played in this scope.
columnHelp.gd: Goal difference of the team, from its own side.
columnHelp.team_minutes: Team-minutes observed in this state (each match contributes both sides).
columnHelp.matches: Matches in which the state occurred.
columnHelp.goals: Goals scored in this transition and bin (model sample).
columnHelp.ci_lo: Lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval.
columnHelp.ci_hi: Upper end of the 95% bootstrap interval.
columnHelp.sparse: Seen in fewer than 30 matches: read with care.

datasetHelp.Goals+Assists: One row per player and team. A goal credits its scorer and its SCA1 (FBref's first shot-creating action), once per player, so a self-created goal counts once. EP is summed at the time-aware value of each goal.
datasetHelp.Goalscorer: Goals only, credited to the scorer.
datasetHelp.Assist: SCA1 credits only. '(unassisted)' collects goals with no recorded shot-creating action.
datasetHelp.State values: Expected final points of a team at that goal difference during a minute in that bin, from every team-minute of the model sample. ci_lo / ci_hi: 95% bootstrap interval over matches. Cells seen in fewer than 30 matches are flagged sparse.
datasetHelp.Goal values: What a goal from gd_before to gd_after is worth in that bin: the gap between the two state values. minute_bin 'all' is the time-blind value.
